text:
jess_support: Customer ACME reports invoice for March shows ~1.8M tokens but the Console dashboard's usage for their project shows ~1.2M. They attached a csv with timestamps — spikes around 2026-02-28T03:12:xxZ and 03:21:xxZ. Can we sanity-check for resends or gateway-side retries?

deepak_billing: thanks — can you paste the invoice id and project id? I'll start a quick diff against our metering ledger.

jess_support: invoice INV-20260301-ACME-77, project acme-prod-42. Customer says they saw a few client timeouts in their mobile app right before the big spike.

mike_ingress: noted. I'm going to pull ingress logs for that project/time range. Any hint if the client sends an Idempotency-Key?

jess_support: customer attached a mobile SDK log snippet, most responses were 504 then later 200s, but I don't see idempotency headers in their logs.

olivia_mobile: that SDK version (v1.3.2) had an aggressive auto-retry on network errors and used a best-effort Idempotency header only when the app explicitly set it. Lots of mobile devs don't set it. Could be duplicates.

mike_ingress: pulled edge logs for acme-prod-42: saw replayed requests for the same session ids coming from two different client IPs within ~10s windows. Example: 

```
[2026-02-28T03:12:05Z] req_id=ry-0a1 src=10.7.5.21 path=/v1/generate status=504
[2026-02-28T03:12:14Z] req_id=ry-0a1 src=35.44.9.8 path=/v1/generate status=200
```

headers show no Idempotency-Key and client User-Agent is "acme-mobile/4.7.0".

deepak_billing: ledger shows two token writes for the same external session and similar prompt hashes at 03:12:14 and 03:12:15 — both billed. That aligns with double-count.

jess_support: customer claims mobile app retried automatically after network flake. They want a credit if we find duplicate billing.

olivia_mobile: we should repro: run the SDK with network drop mid-request then let it auto-retry. I'll try to reproduce locally with v1.3.2.

ops-bot: deployment mike/edge-ratefix completed in 2026-02-28T04:01:12Z :white_check_mark:

mike_ingress: reproduction steps that match logs: 
1) Send a request that takes > 7s server side (we simulate slow model)
2) Client receives a network timeout at 6s and auto-retries without Idempotency-Key
3) Edge accepts both requests and forwards to serving; serving finishes both -> double tokens.

Snippet I used: 
```
# simulate slow response and client auto-retry
curl -X POST https://edge.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" --data '{"prompt":"<long compute>","max_tokens":1024}' --max-time 6 || true
# SDK retries immediately after timeout without idempotency
```

deepak_billing: thanks. For the immediate customer ask: I'll open a support credit case and flag all matching request pairs (same prompt hash, no idempotency, same project) in the March window for manual audit. We can credit obvious duplicates.

jess_support: please ping ACME with a short summary and ask if they can set Idempotency-Key in their requests while we sort credits.

olivia_mobile: follow-up: SDK v1.3.3 (rolling next week) will change default to generate a stable Idempotency-Key per request attempt so retries are deduped by default. I'll link the PR.

mike_ingress: operational mitigation we can do now: if we see two near-duplicate requests from same session with identical prompt hash within 30s and no idempotency header, mark the second as "possible-duplicate" and don't immediately write tokens to the ledger until serving ack is reconciled. Needs a short MCC but doable.

deepak_billing: that partial mitigation could prevent new incidents. But we still have to handle past March entries — I'll prepare a credit table and estimate.

jess_support: ACME wants ETA on credits. deepak, can you do a provisional credit by EOD tomorrow and loop legal if needed?

deepak_billing: provisional crediting workflow started. I'll share exact numbers in this thread once I finish the ledger scan.

jess_support: thanks all. I'll update ACME with repro notes and ask them to try the SDK patch when available.

olivia_mobile: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/mobile-sdk/pulls/482 — defaults idempotency and documents retry behaviors.

mike_ingress: created ticket INF-1427 for gateway duplicate suppression logic.

deepak_billing: ledger scan results (quick summary): ~560k tokens suspected duplicate in that March window for acme-prod-42. Proposing to issue credit of 560k tokens worth on their April invoice and mark incident for postmortem.

jess_support: good. ACME replied: "Thanks. We'll enable Idempotency-Key today and confirm after one deployment." I'll post back when they confirm.

ops-bot: incident assigned to eng-oncall @mike_ingress at 2026-02-28T05:12:00Z

mike_ingress: will follow up with SRE and schedule a short postmortem next week.

jess_support: closing loop for now — action items: deepak issue provisional credit, olivia ship SDK change, mike implement gateway suppression, support confirm with ACME once they enable idempotency.

jess_support: marking thread resolved locally but keeping on-watch until credits complete and customer confirms.
